title: Tailwise Autoship Households: Admin Fee Withheld from Grooming Pass Refunds
content:
**Care Desk Guidance — admin fee on refunds of cancelled Tailwise Grooming Salon prepaid passes** (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes) for households that order through Tailwise Autoship.

The admin fee withheld on a cancelled pass follows the household's charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated within the last 6 whole calendar months, skipped shipments not counting:

- at least 6 charged shipments waive the refund admin fee;
- at least 3 but fewer than 6 charged shipments withhold half (0.5) of the refund admin fee;
- fewer than 3 charged shipments withhold all of the refund admin fee.

**Refund admin fee by pass and the amount withheld (USD)**

| Pass | Refund admin fee | 6 or more shipments | 3 to 5 shipments | 0 to 2 shipments |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 10.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 10.00 |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 10.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 10.00 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 15.00 | 0.00 | 7.50 | 15.00 |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 15.00 | 0.00 | 7.50 | 15.00 |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 15.00 | 0.00 | 7.50 | 15.00 |

(Groom Club Monthly carries a refund admin fee of 0.00.)

**Counting the shipments.** The shipments are read from the Tailwise Autoship history of the customer's subscriptions, across all of them: each shipment charged within the window counts once; a skipped shipment does not count.

**Examples (hypothetical households)**

| Autoship history in the last 6 whole calendar months | Count | Admin fee withheld on a Full Groom Pass 4-Visit refund |
|---|---|---|
| one subscription charged every month, six shipments | 6 | 0.00 |
| two subscriptions, two charged shipments each, one skip | 4 | 7.50 |
| one charged shipment and three skips | 1 | 15.00 |
| no Autoship subscription | 0 | 15.00 |
